title: Unit and counit evaluation in the fixed tower coordinates
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, the section-model base $b$, and a scheme map $f:X\to Y$ with its recorded geometry $g$ [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. At each positive level $n+1$, the specified inverse-image and direct-image evaluation comparisons carry the derived system adjunction unit and counit to the canonical finite derived adjunction unit and counit [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Explicitly, writing $e_X,e_Y$ for evaluation, $L,R$ for the system adjoints, $l,r$ for the finite adjoints, and $a:Le_X\simeq e_Yl$, $b:Re_Y\simeq e_Xr$ for the prescribed comparisons, $e_Y(\eta_M);b_{LM};r(a_M)=\eta_{e_YM}$ and $l(b_N);\varepsilon_{e_XN}=a^{-1}_{RN};e_X(\varepsilon_N)$. No tensor product or invertibility of projection maps is asserted.

proof.text: Pass only the needed coefficient and operation projections to the proved private geometry_evaluation_transport helper, avoiding reconstruction of the large geometry records. Substitute the coefficient, transition, pull and push equalities; the derived system adjunctions are then homogeneously equal. Project the bundled ordinary finite-adjunction normalization and localize it using the proved private derived_package_eq helper. Rewrite the generic derivedLevelAdjunction_canonical equality. The private evaluation_coordinates helper eliminates the package equality, the two comparison HEqs, and the system-adjunction equality. The two resulting goals are precisely generic.unit_evaluation and generic.counit_evaluation. No equality of maps is inferred from levelwise equality.

lean.statement:
theorem geometry_adjunction_evaluation (b : Base l E)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (g : Geometry l E b f) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ M : D l E Y,
      (Ev l E Y n).map ((adjunction l E b g).unit.app M) ≫
        (g.pushEvaluation n).hom.app ((pull l E b g).obj M) ≫
        (proEtaleConstantRingPushforward (R l E n) f).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((g.pullEvaluation n).hom.app M) =
      (Adjunction.unit
        (proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (R l E n) f).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction).app
        ((Ev l E Y n).obj M)) ∧
    (∀ N : D l E X,
      (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback (R l E n) f).map
          ((g.pushEvaluation n).hom.app N) ≫
        (Adjunction.counit
          (proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (R l E n) f).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction).app
          ((Ev l E X n).obj N) =
      (g.pullEvaluation n).inv.app ((push l E b g).obj N) ≫
        (Ev l E X n).map ((adjunction l E b g).counit.app N))
